app_fee.value: The catalog requires an application fee but does not state its amount for graduate applicants.
app_fee.quote: An applicant for admission to graduate-level study must file an application with the Graduate School and pay the appropriate application fee.

gre_general.value: Each program sets its own GRE rule; check the program entry.
